notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.6.2r
notes.content: [p]v1.6.2r[/p][list][*][p]World 1: Added button prompt for bomb fruit arming[/p][/*][*][p]World 3: Improved snowboarding physics[/p][/*][*][p]World 5: Fixed possible soft lock after collecting all ingredients  [/p][/*][*][p]Added "Hand Color" to general settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some recipe steps showing as completed too early [/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.6.1r
notes.content:
v1.6.1r
[list]
[*] World 2: [spoiler]Fixed tree house physics bug[/spoiler]
[*] World 2: [spoiler]Fixed stuck mill door[/spoiler]
[*] World 3: [spoiler]Fixed flower boy throwing snowballs while player is inside cabin[/spoiler]
[*] Carrot and Ice Pepper stems no longer need to be cut to not be considered "too big" 
[*] Ingredients are no longer locked out of cut mode after being prepped
[*] Potential fix for rare bug causing corrupted screen from invalid player colliders  
[*] Fixed issue with player physics rig when holding two items  
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.6.0.0r
notes.content:
v1.6.0.0r
[list]
[*] Significantly improved performance
[*] Fixed OpenXR Quest inputs
[*] World 4: [spoiler]Minor ice axe adjustments[/spoiler]
[*] World 5: [spoiler]Reduced enemy bomb throw rate in ice climbing area[/spoiler]
[*] Added fog and cloud quality to graphics settings. Cloud quality defaults to "low"; former appearance can be restored at "very high"
[*] Fixed cases where some UI elements would become unresponsive
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.5.9.1r
notes.content:
v1.5.9.1r
[list]
[*] World 1: [spoiler]Draw arrow prompt no longer hides itself when an arrow from the table is fired[/spoiler]
[*] World 2: [spoiler]Improved mill collisions. Reduced tendency for hands to clip though walls and made climbing the stairs more consistent[/spoiler]
[*] Added an OpenXR branch. You can switch to OpenXR by right-clicking the game in your library -> Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation -> open_xr
[*] Added drag to ingredients to stop them from rolling forever
[*] Fixed spectator camera grass culling issues
[*] Fixed fence texture
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.5.9.0r
notes.content:
v1.5.9.0r
[list]
[*] World 3: [spoiler]Adjusted ice climbing physics. The axe should now be much easier to pull out intentionally, dislodge by accident less frequently, and pierce more consistently. [/spoiler]
[*] World 3: [spoiler]Ice axes now holster to player's hip when dropped[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed invisible inventory bubbles in some maps
[*] Added a "Smooth Turn Deadzone" setting
[*] Increased smooth turn max speed
[*] Fixed getting stuck using teleport locomotion in main menu
[*] Reduced camera near clipping plane (less clipping when head is close to walls)
[*] Fixed several memory leaks
[*] Fixed invisible fish bones
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.5.8.1r
notes.content:
[list]
[*] World 1: Fixed [spoiler]arrows sometimes feeling heavy[/spoiler]
[*] World 3: Fixed [spoiler]snowboard losing speed faster than intended when going uphill[/spoiler]
[*] World 3:  [spoiler]Slightly increased initial snowboard acceleration[/spoiler]
[*] World 3: Fixed cases where [spoiler]snowboard would lose momentum on ramps[/spoiler]
[*] World 4: Fixed [spoiler]not being able to grab mochi ball[/spoiler]
[*] World 5: Fixed potential soft lock
[*] Fixed rare physics bug causing player to lose friction
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.5.8r
notes.content:
v1.5.8r
[list]
[*] Reduced stuttering
[*] Improved CPU performance
[*] Reduced memory usage
[*] Can now toggle crouch with main hand joystick press
[*] Adjusted volume of some characters
[*] Fixed missing climb indicators in tutorial area when teleport locomotion is enabled
[*] Fixed getting stuck when returning to [spoiler]coalbold boss[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Widened powered up bomb fruit auto-aim angle[/spoiler]
[*] Improved player physics
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Try Umami Grove during the Steam VR Fest!
notes.content:
Heads up everyone!

This may be the last chance to play Umami Grove before the official release!✨ 

The demo will be available until the end of the Steam VR Fest. This version includes many performance optimizations and bug fixes since the last demo.

Try it today!

- Pomshine Games

[previewyoutube=suunF7Wp8sY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
We have implement the following changes to the demo build:
[list]
[*] Based on feedback, character dialogue now requires input to progress by default. Original functionality can be bought back in Settings>General
[*] Added text boxes to character dialogue
[*] Fixed a bug causing lost inventory items
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]
Thank you very much for the support!

- Pomshine Games

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
We are extremely excited to announce that we will be working with DANGEN Entertainment as our publisher! See the official Umami Grove website below!
https://umamigrove.dangenentertainment.com/

And by the way, a new demo is also now available until July 17th!

- Pomshine Games

notes.title: The VR Fest Demo Has Now Ended!
notes.content:
The Steam VR Fest demo for Umami Grove is officially over. 

Thanks to everyone who played, We really appreciated your feedback and will adjust the game accordingly!

- Pomshine Games

notes.title: Umami Grove Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
We were a bit late getting ready but the Steam VR Fest demo for Umami Grove is now available for the next 48 hours! The demo will run from now until the day following the end of the fest.

Please let us know what you think!

- Pomshine Games
